name: OpenStreetMap
description: Open map data for places, roads, and geographic context.
licensing_notes: OpenStreetMap data is available under the Open Database License (ODbL); attribution is required.

name: Google Maps Platform
description: Mapping, places, routing, and geocoding services.
licensing_notes: Requires an API key and a billing account. Usage is governed by the Google Maps Platform Terms of Service.

name: OpenWeather
description: Current weather, forecasts, and weather alerts.
licensing_notes: API key required. Free and paid plans are available; review OpenWeather attribution and plan terms.

name: Open-Meteo
description: Open weather forecasts and historical weather data.
licensing_notes: Free for non-commercial use. Commercial use requires a paid API key and plan.

name: World Bank Open Data
description: Global development indicators and economic datasets.
licensing_notes: Open data under CC BY 4.0; attribution required.

name: Data.gov
description: Catalog of US federal, state, and local open datasets.
licensing_notes: US federal open data is generally public domain; individual datasets may carry their own licenses, so check each dataset.

name: OpenAI API
description: Language models for summarization, reasoning, and generation.
licensing_notes: API key and paid usage required. Use is governed by the OpenAI terms and model policies.

name: Hugging Face Inference
description: Hosted inference for open models across text and other tasks.
licensing_notes: Access token required. The free tier is limited, and each model carries its own license.

name: Foursquare Places API
description: Place search, venue details, and local points of interest.
licensing_notes: API key required. Free tier and paid plans are available; attribution and usage terms apply.

name: Overpass API
description: Query OpenStreetMap for places, amenities, and local features.
licensing_notes: Returns OpenStreetMap data under the ODbL. Respect the public instance usage policy and rate limits.

name: Frankfurter
description: Exchange rates from the European Central Bank.
licensing_notes: Free, open-source exchange-rate API built on European Central Bank reference rates.

name: CoinGecko API
description: Cryptocurrency prices, market data, and trends.
licensing_notes: A demo API key is required for the free tier. Rate limits and attribution terms apply.

name: WHO Global Health Observatory
description: Global public-health indicators and country statistics.
licensing_notes: Free access with attribution. WHO data is generally published under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO; confirm terms for your use.

name: CDC Open Data
description: US public-health datasets and surveillance indicators.
licensing_notes: US federal public health data; most datasets are public domain, but check each dataset's license.

name: GDELT Project
description: Global news event and media monitoring data.
licensing_notes: Free and open; attribution is requested. Review the GDELT terms before commercial use.

name: NewsAPI
description: Search and retrieve news articles from many publishers.
licensing_notes: API key required. The free developer tier is for development only; production use requires a paid plan.

name: OpenAlex
description: Open scholarly metadata for works, authors, and institutions.
licensing_notes: Scholarly metadata is available under CC0. Use the polite pool by identifying your contact email.

name: Crossref REST API
description: Scholarly metadata, DOI records, and citation information.
licensing_notes: Free public metadata API. Crossref terms and member-provided metadata licenses apply.

name: PostHog
description: Product analytics, events, and feature flags.
licensing_notes: Project API key required. Free tier and paid plans are available; self-hosting is supported.

name: Umami
description: Privacy-focused web analytics, self-hosted or hosted.
licensing_notes: Open-source and self-hostable. Cloud plans require an account; self-hosted use follows the project license.

name: NASA POWER
description: Solar and meteorological data for renewable energy, agriculture, and climate analysis.
licensing_notes: No API key is required. NASA POWER asks users to cite the project; review the POWER documentation and NASA data-use guidance before redistribution.

name: National Weather Service API
description: US forecasts, observations, and weather alerts from the National Weather Service.
licensing_notes: No API key is required. Identify your application with a User-Agent header and review the NWS API documentation before production use.

name: USDA FoodData Central
description: US food composition and nutrition data for foods and branded products.
licensing_notes: A free API key is required. US government data is generally public domain; review the API guide and dataset-specific notices.

name: Open Food Facts
description: Open, crowdsourced food product data, including ingredients, nutrition, and labels.
licensing_notes: The open database is available under the Open Database License (ODbL) with attribution and share-alike terms; images and contents have their own licenses.

name: US Census American Community Survey
description: US demographic, income, housing, and neighborhood estimates from the American Community Survey.
licensing_notes: A free Census API key is recommended and required above the unauthenticated daily limit. Census Bureau data is public domain; review API and vintage notes.

name: HUD Fair Market Rents and Income Limits
description: Fair Market Rents and income limits by state, county, and metro area.
licensing_notes: A HUD User API access token is required. Review the HUD User API Terms of Service and dataset documentation before redistributing data.

name: MBTA V3 API
description: Boston-area transit routes, stops, schedules, predictions, and service alerts.
licensing_notes: A free API key is required. Review the MBTA API documentation and the MBTA open data license before redistributing data.

name: Transitland
description: Aggregated public transit feeds, routes, stops, and operators across regions.
licensing_notes: An API key is required. Free and paid plans are available; review Transitland terms and the licenses of the underlying GTFS feeds.

name: Zenodo
description: Open repository for research outputs, datasets, software, and DOI records.
licensing_notes: Public records can be read without a token; a personal access token is required for deposits. Metadata is released under CC0 and files keep their uploaded licenses.

name: arXiv API
description: Preprint metadata and full-text links across physics, mathematics, computer science, and related fields.
licensing_notes: No API key is required. Follow the arXiv API usage policy and request pacing; article licenses vary by paper.
